help_menu:
Click the buttons below to get information about my commands.

Note: All commands can be used with /
help_admins:
Admin commands:
/pause – Pause stream
/resume – Resume stream
/skip – Skip stream
/stop – Stop stream
/reload – Reload admin cache
help_auth:
Auth commands:
/auth – Add user to auth list
/unauth – Remove user from auth list
help_blist:
Blacklist commands:
/blacklist – Block chat or user
/unblacklist – Unblock chat or user
help_ping:
Ping commands:
/ping – Check ping
/help – Help menu
help_play:
Play commands:
/play – Play audio
/vplay – Play video
/play -f – Force play
help_sudo:
Sudo commands:
/broadcast – Broadcast message
/restart – Restart bot
/eval – Execute code
